MODEL AND ACTUAL SELECTED TRAINING

Selected logical phase: C3
Selected adapter weight SHA256: f36ce52e0690e8eefe2cfb26aa5d0f2c37f629a49f7ecd8063a37980233ee496
Pinned Base: Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B revision
6a9e13bd6fc8f0983b9b99948120bc37f49c13e9.

This is ONE joint logical specification LoRA. It reads supplied metadata and
source definitions, and proposes typed logical plans, roles, scope and exceptions.
Code validates and measures plans, then exports nullable-Boolean features and
rules that reference their IDs/definition SHA. That projection is not a second
Feature-LLM call. The original numerical Feature-51 and Rule-527 adapters and
frozen IF/K-means/LOF models remain separate and unchanged.

Effective training lineage
  C0: 264 train / 66 validation, one complete epoch, 66 optimizer steps; parent original frozen Base.
  C1: 336 train / 84 validation, one complete epoch, 84 optimizer steps; parent C0.
  C3: 400 train / 100 validation, one complete epoch, 100 optimizer steps; parent C1.
Recorded effective training-example exposures: 1000.
Distinct recorded example IDs in that lineage: 468.
Repeated ancestor examples are exposures, not new independent training examples.
C2 and C3 are separate continuations from C1, not successive phases. If selected,
C4 continues from audited C3. The interrupted
12-step C2 attempt was preserved and its partial weights are not in this lineage.

All selected phases used AI-authored, reviewed, code-checked synthetic silver
instruction/context/answer pairs. These are not expert-confirmed company incidents.
No company CSV rows, current private evaluation answers or model responses were
training targets. Operator families overlap train/validation. Exact input hashes
are disjoint within each phase; this does not prove independent operator families.

NF4 double quantization, BF16 compute, LoRA rank8/alpha16/dropout0.05; 304 language
modules, 608 adapter tensors, 23,760,896 trainable parameters. AdamW LR1e-4,
accumulation4, clipping1.0, seed42, maximum8192 tokens with no truncation. Only
assistant-answer and EOS tokens contribute to cross-entropy. Base and vision are
frozen. Gradient checkpointing and CPU embedding/head/activation offload fit the
assigned exposed GPU. Each continuation starts a fresh optimizer.

Independent audits checked full selected epoch consumption, finite saved LoRA
tensors and actual adapter changes. Frozen gradients and sampled Base values were
checked during training; the whole in-memory Base was not independently compared.
Protected original on-disk sources are audited separately by SHA. Validation NLL
and formal validity alone do not establish generation quality.

Limits
Source citations and typed checks do not prove arbitrary natural-language meaning.
The model may omit required checks or exceptions. Administrators review candidate
meaning and scope before activation. Unsupported operations and unknown meanings
remain unavailable or evidence requests. Rules are recommendations, not confirmed
incident labels. No claim is made that ML in general cannot learn relations. The
concrete added function is translating supplied meanings into explicit, reusable
source-bound predicates. New Boolean features are not silently added to old ML
input vectors. This bundle has no backend DB/API or alert delivery service.

See selected_training_history.json and training_data/index.json for actual pins.
